wholePhysicalScope: Current named Giác Lâm precinct and inner-hall building relation, with the three linked hall rows resolved from the roof proportions and mapped courts. Forecourt stupa placement is approximate.
lodDetails: Four authored levels retain the three long tile roofs and stepped seven-storey relic stupa.
limitations: The current main hall, two linked rear hall rows and relic stupa constitute the exterior model. The map controls the hall envelope and the two open wells. Roof ridge heights and rear service elevations are estimates.

The current relic stupa stands on the left of the entrance and south of the halls. Exact stupa outline and surveyed coordinates are unavailable in the native map, so its location and width are approximated within the precinct.
The scale-appropriate exterior omits individual tombs, interior features, sculpture inscriptions and the subsidiary monastic outbuildings.
